content: तद् {%<ab>pron. a.</ab>%} (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> सः {%m.%}, सा {%f.%}, तत् {%n.%}) .²1 That referring to something not present; (तदिति परोक्षे विजानीयात्). .²2 He, she, it; (<ab>oft.</ab> as <ab>corr.</ab> of यद्); यस्य बुद्धिर्बलं तस्य <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²3 That, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} well-known; सा रम्या नगरी महान्स नृपतिः सामन्तचक्रं च तत् <ls>Bh. 3. 37</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 71</ls>. .²4 That (referring to something seen or experienced before, अनुभूतार्थः); उत्कम्पिनी भयपरिस्खलितांशुकान्ता ते लोचने प्रतिदिशं विधुरे क्षिपन्ती <ls>K. P. 7</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 5</ls>. .²5 The same, identical, that, very; usually with एव; तानीन्द्रियाणि सकलानि तदेव नाम <ls>Bh. 2. 40</ls>. Sometimes the forms of तद् are used with the first and second personal pronouns, as well as with demonstratives and relatives, for the sake of emphasis; (often translatable by ‘therefore’, ‘then’); सोऽहमिज्याविशुद्धात्मा <ls>R. 1. 69</ls>; ‘I that very person’, ‘I therefore’; (I who am so and so); स त्वं निवर्तस्व विहाय लज्जाम् <ls n="R.">2. 40</ls> ‘thou, therefore, shouldst return’, <ab>&c.</ab> When repeated तद् has the sense of ‘several’, ‘various’; तेषु तेषु स्थानेषु <ls>K. 369</ls>; <ls>Bg. 7. 20</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1. 36</ls>; ते ते भावाः <ls n="Māl.">1. 17</ls>. तेन the <ab>instr.</ab> of तद् is often used with adverbial force in the sense of ‘therefore’, ‘on that account’, ‘in that case’, ‘for that reason’. तेन हि if so, well then. --{%ind.%} .²1 There, thither. .²2 Then, in that case, at that time. .²3 For that reason, therefore, consequently; तदेहि विमर्दक्षमां भूमिमवतरावः <ls>U. 5</ls>; <ls>Me. 7</ls>, <ls n="Me.">109</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 46</ls>. .²4 Then (<ab>corr.</ab> of यदि); तथापि यदि महत्कुतूहलं तत्कथयामि <ls>K. 136</ls>; <ls>Bg. 1. 46</ls>. --{%n.%} .²1 The Supreme Spirit or Brahman; तद्भावभावी तद्बुद्धिः <ls>Mb. 12. 323. 29</ls>; <ls>Bg. 17. 23</ls>. .²2 This world.
